component.name: Hotspot Share
component.summary: High-speed local Wi-Fi file sharing and clipboard synchronization

description.p: Hotspot Share is a lightning-fast, zero-cloud local file transfer and clipboard synchronization tool designed for Linux and mobile devices (Android, iOS).

ul.li: High-throughput Wi-Fi 6 chunked file uploads and downloads with pause and resume support.
Instant bi-directional clipboard sync for text and images (Ctrl+V ready).
Pure browser-based mobile interface — no app installation required on the phone.
Interactive QR code scanning for effortless device pairing.
On-the-fly streaming directory zipping for downloading entire folders.
Optional 4-digit PIN pairing authentication for public networks.
Built-in Wi-Fi Hotspot management with NetworkManager.
Native desktop notifications, system tray indicator, and file manager integration.

screenshot.caption: High-speed Wi-Fi 6 multi-file transfers, real-time speed indicators, and cancellable transfer queue
Mobile web app interface with upload progress, live speedometer, and responsive controls
File Explorer with directory navigation, audio and video previews, and on-the-fly ZIP download
Bi-directional multimodal clipboard synchronization for instant text, code, and image sharing
Instant QR code smartphone pairing and secure PIN authentication dashboard

description.p: Pre-release security audit, vulnerability fixes, and binary hardening:

ul.li: Restrict CORS and add Host header validation against DNS rebinding.
Fix stored XSS via inline attribute escaping in file/folder lists and AirDrop beams.
Enforce strict token authentication and restrict remote hotspot interface control.
Isolate untrusted download content with Content-Disposition, nosniff, and CSP sandbox.
Harden desktop WebKit navigation policy prefix checks and add binary compiler hardening flags.

description.p: Production reliability, full snap synchronization, and desktop zoom lockdown:

ul.li: Prevent UDP broadcast loopstorms by strictly replying to ping and discover queries.
Synchronize all snap staging runtimes and asset directories.
Hardware desktop zoom suppression and non-passive gesture prevention.
Graceful in-card unpairing and session disconnect workflow.

description.p: Native desktop zoom suppression, mobile tour cleanup, and graceful unpairing:

ul.li: Suppress trackpad pinch-zoom, multi-touch gestures, and Ctrl+zoom keys in GTK WebKit.
Remove Re-open Tour button on mobile web for clean presentation.
Fix phone unpairing endpoint, properly revoking sessions and updating real-time UI states.
Replace native Android popups with graceful in-card unpairing and disconnect confirmation sheets.

description.p: Mobile web optimization: remove desktop keyboard shortcuts from mobile web view:

ul.li: Hide desktop keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet on mobile phones and touch devices.
Ensure clean, uncluttered About view on mobile web.

description.p: Mobile web UX overhaul: 5-column CSS grid navigation, non-overlapping badge, smooth native touch scrolling, and tab-aware incoming beams:

ul.li: Redesigned mobile navigation bar into a clean 5-column CSS Grid with distinct vertical icon-and-label layout.
Pinned file notification badge as an absolute counter to prevent layout shift and overlapping with Clipboard.
Restored smooth native momentum touch scrolling across mobile Safari and Android browsers.
Made incoming transfer beams tab-aware and added batch download and dismissal controls.
Added automatic scroll-to-top on tab changes for instant section visibility.

description.p: Header navigation cleanup, graceful About icon, and single onboarding skip button:

ul.li: Removed duplicate About and Security buttons from header actions for clean, consolidated navigation.
Added graceful, commercially accepted circular outline icon for About tab.
Streamlined onboarding tour with a single top-level Skip button.

description.p: Dedicated desktop About tab, native zoom controls, and tour skip:

ul.li: Dedicated About tab section replacing modal popups for a native desktop feel.
Clean, understated version typography without colorful badges or gradients.
Quick Skip button on product tour for frictionless onboarding.
Hardware trackpad pinch zoom suppression for full native application behavior.
Native keyboard shortcuts (Alt+1..5, Ctrl+O, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+T, Ctrl+R).
Modularized backend architecture with zero pip dependencies.
PIN code pairing authorization for public networks.
Dynamic port binding and XDG runtime file management.
System tray indicator and desktop notification support.
Nautilus right-click file sharing integration.
AppStream, Snapcraft, Flatpak, and Debian store packaging support.
